ROOT.scriptdef: if exists (select * from dbo.sysobjects where id = object_id(N'CDN.ESKLEP_EksportTwrProducent') and OBJECTPROPERTY(id, N'IsProcedure') = 1) drop procedure CDN.ESKLEP_EksportTwrProducent

CREATE PROCEDURE [CDN].[ESKLEP_EksportTwrProducent] @ID INT -- ID e-sklepu ,@TypExp INT -- Typ eksportu (0 - różnicowy, 1 - pełny) AS
SELECT DISTINCT Knt_GIDNumer AS PdrID , Knt_Akronim AS ProducentKod , CDN.XLValidateXMLChars(ISNULL(RTRIM(Knt_Nazwa1 +' '+ Knt_Nazwa2 +' ' + Knt_Nazwa3),'')) AS ProducentNazwa , ISNULL(Knt_URL,'') AS ProducentURL , (SELECT top 1 DAO_DABId FROM CDN.DaneObiekty JOIN CDN.DaneBinarne ON DAO_DABId = DAB_ID JOIN CDN.Slowniki ON SLW_ID = DAB_TypId JOIN CDN.SlownikiStruktura ON SLS_ID = SLW_SLSID AND SLS_Predefiniowany = 64 AND SLW_Predefiniowany = 1 AND SLW_WartoscN1 = -1 WHERE DAO_ObiTyp = PDR.Knt_GIDTyp AND DAO_ObiNumer = PDR.Knt_GIDNumer AND DAB_eSklep = 1 order by DAO_Pozycja) AS ProducentLogo FROM CDN.TwrKarty JOIN CDN.TwrCeny A ON Twr_GIDNumer = A.TwC_TwrNumer JOIN CDN.PicoKonfig ON Pck_PicoId = @ID JOIN CDN.TwrGrupy PCKTWG ON PCKTWG.TwG_SyncId = PcK_TwGNumer AND PCKTWG.TwG_GIDTyp = -16 LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.PicoCenniki ON PcC_PcKID=@ID and PcC_TwCTwrTyp=64 AND PcC_TwCTwrNumer=A.TwC_ID and PcC_TwCTwrLp = 0 JOIN CDN.KntKarty PDR ON Twr_PrdNumer = Knt_GIDNumer AND Twr_PrdTyp = Knt_GIDTyp LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.PicoLog ON PcL_PcKID = Pck_PicoId AND PcL_ObiTyp = Twr_GIDTyp AND PcL_ObiNumer = Twr_GIDNumer WHERE A.TwC_TwrLp IN (PcK_NrCeny, PcK_NrCenyDomyslnej) AND Twr_GIDNumer > 0 AND Twr_eSklep = 1 AND Twr_Archiwalny = 0 AND (A.twc_czasmodyfikacji > CASE WHEN @TypExp=0 AND ISNULL(PcC_TS,0) > 0 THEN PcK_TSSynchrTwrPtw ELSE 0 END OR ISNULL(PcL_TStamp,PcK_TSSynchrTwrPtw + 1) > PcK_TSSynchrTwrPtw) AND A.TwC_ID = ( SELECT TOP 1 B.TwC_ID FROM CDN.TwrCeny B WHERE B.TwC_TwrNumer = Twr_GIDNumer AND B.TwC_TwrLp = A.TwC_TwrLp AND B.TwC_DataOd <= DATEDIFF(s,CONVERT(DATETIME,'1990-01-01',120),GETDATE()) ORDER BY B.TwC_TwrLp,B.TwC_DataOd DESC ) AND EXISTS(SELECT TwL_GrONumer FROM CDN.TwrLinki WHERE Twr_GIDTyp = TwL_GIDTyp AND Twr_GIDNumer = TwL_GIDNumer AND TwL_GrONumer = PCKTWG.TwG_GIDNumer ) FOR XML AUTO
DECLARE @CennikiTmp TABLE(TWCID INT) INSERT INTO @CennikiTmp SELECT TwC_ID FROM CDN.TwrKarty JOIN CDN.TwrCeny A ON Twr_GIDNumer = A.TwC_TwrNumer JOIN CDN.PicoKonfig ON Pck_PicoId = @ID JOIN CDN.TwrGrupy PCKTWG ON PCKTWG.TwG_SyncId = PcK_TwGNumer AND PCKTWG.TwG_GIDTyp = -16 LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.PicoCenniki ON PcC_PcKID=@ID and PcC_TwCTwrTyp=64 AND PcC_TwCTwrNumer=A.TwC_ID and PcC_TwCTwrLp = 0 JOIN CDN.KntKarty PDR ON Twr_PrdNumer = Knt_GIDNumer AND Twr_PrdTyp = Knt_GIDTyp LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.PicoLog ON PcL_PcKID = Pck_PicoId AND PcL_ObiTyp = Twr_GIDTyp AND PcL_ObiNumer = Twr_GIDNumer WHERE A.TwC_TwrLp IN (PcK_NrCeny, PcK_NrCenyDomyslnej) AND Twr_GIDNumer > 0 AND Twr_eSklep = 1 AND Twr_Archiwalny = 0 AND (A.twc_czasmodyfikacji > CASE WHEN @TypExp=0 AND ISNULL(PcC_TS,0) > 0 THEN PcK_TSSynchrTwrPtw ELSE 0 END OR ISNULL(PcL_TStamp,PcK_TSSynchrTwrPtw + 1) > PcK_TSSynchrTwrPtw) AND A.TwC_ID = ( SELECT TOP 1 B.TwC_ID FROM CDN.TwrCeny B WHERE B.TwC_TwrNumer = Twr_GIDNumer AND B.TwC_TwrLp = A.TwC_TwrLp AND B.TwC_DataOd <= DATEDIFF(s,CONVERT(DATETIME,'1990-01-01',120),GETDATE()) ORDER BY B.TwC_TwrLp,B.TwC_DataOd DESC ) AND EXISTS(SELECT TwL_GrONumer FROM CDN.TwrLinki WHERE Twr_GIDTyp = TwL_GIDTyp AND Twr_GIDNumer = TwL_GIDNumer AND TwL_GrONumer = PCKTWG.TwG_GIDNumer )
DELETE A FROM cdn.PicoCenniki A JOIN @CennikiTmp ON TWCID = A.PcC_TwCTwrNumer WHERE PcC_PcKID = @ID AND PcC_TwCTwrTyp = 64 AND PcC_TwCTwrLp = 0
INSERT INTO cdn.PicoCenniki (PcC_TwCTwrTyp, PcC_TwCTwrNumer, PcC_TwCTwrLp, PcC_PcKID, PcC_TS) SELECT 64, TWCID, 0, @ID, DATEDIFF(s,CONVERT(DATETIME,'1990-01-01',120),GETDATE()) FROM @CennikiTmp
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.ESKLEP_EksportTwrProducent TO CDNRaport
